'''Place in Hibernation Trance''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]] and [[Force power/Legends#Alter|Alter]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] to place another being in a [[Hibernation trance/Legends|Hibernation trance]] to receive the benefits of it. The Force user had to be in contact with the individual being targeted, and it had to be a consensual act; it could not be used as a form of attack.<ref name="RPG" />
